messages.content:
There’s currently no code or framework set up in your workspace — so we’ll create a fresh project from scratch.  

Let’s build a **Pac-Man clone in Python using Pygame**, since that’s compact and easily playable.

Next workflow: create a folder, install Pygame if needed, and scaffold the minimal playable Pac-Man with movement and walls.

function.name: workflow_orchestrator
function.arguments: {"name": "setup_pacman_clone", "type": "sequential", "steps": [{"tool": "shell_exec", "args": {"command": "mkdir pacman_clone", "working_directory": "$profile.workspace"}, "store_result_as": "$dir", "description": "Create a project folder for the Pac-Man clone."}, {"tool": "shell_exec", "args": {"command": "pip install pygame"}, "store_result_as": "$install", "description": "Install the Pygame library needed to render the game."}, {"tool": "file_write", "args": {"path": "$profile.workspace/pacman_clone/pacman.py", "content": "import pygame, sys\\nfrom pygame.locals import *\\n\\npygame.init()\\n\\nWIDTH, HEIGHT = 448, 576\\nTILE = 16\\nWINDOW = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))\\npygame.display.set_caption('Pacman Clone')\\n\\nclock = pygame.time.Clock()\\n\\nplayer_img = pygame.Surface((TILE, TILE))\\nplayer_img.fill((255, 255, 0))\\nplayer_x, player_y = WIDTH//2, HEIGHT//2\\n\\nspeed = 4\\n\\nrunning = True\\nwhile running:\\n    for event in pygame.event.get():\\n        if event.type == QUIT:\\n            pygame.quit()\\n            sys.exit()\\n\\n    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()\\n    if keys[K_LEFT]: player_x -= speed\\n    if keys[K_RIGHT]: player_x += speed\\n    if keys[K_UP]: player_y -= speed\\n    if keys[K_DOWN]: player_y += speed\\n\\n    WINDOW.fill((0, 0, 0))\\n    WINDOW.blit(player_img, (player_x, player_y))\\n    pygame.display.flip()\\n    clock.tick(60)"}, "store_result_as": "$main_file", "description": "Write an initial playable Pac-Man script that shows a yellow square that moves with arrow keys."}]}
